title: Molwetse yo o sa Reketleng
intro: Mo dibukeng tsa hisitori ya boporofeti, ke ba le mmalwa fela ba ba itshoketseng tatlhegelo e e tseneletseng jalo le pogiso ya mmele ka tumelo e e sa reketleng. Kgang ya setshwantsho seno ke thuto e e sa feleng ya bopelotelele le go ikanya botlhale jwa bomodimo. Moya ona ke mang?
clues: Ke ne ka tlhophiwa ke Allah go romela molaetsa, mme teko ya me e kgolo e ne ya tla e seng ka go ganwa, mme ka masetlapelo a botho.
Khumo ya me, leruo la me le bana ba me di ne tsa tsewa mo go nna, ka go latelana ga tsone.
Mmele wa me o ne o tletse dintho, mme ke ne ka sala ke le nosi kwantle ga go tshegediwa ke molekane wa me.
Ke ne ka goela kwa go Morena wa me, ke amogela pogiso ya me le go batla kutlwelobotlhoko ya gagwe.
Ke ne ka laelwa gore ke iteye fa fatshe ka leoto la me, mme ga tswa motswedi o o lapolosang.
Allah o ne a busetsa botsogo jwa me mme a nnaya lelapa le lesha le khumo e e fetang e ke neng ke na le yone pele.

arabic: وَٱذْكُرْ عَبْدَنَآ أَيُّوبَ إِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّى مَسَّنِىَ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنُ بِنُصْبٍۢ وَعَذَابٍ
verse: And remember Our servant Job, when he called to his Lord, "Indeed, Satan has touched me with hardship and torment." (38:41)
